name: Short Trimmed
shortLine: Neat, short moustache that stops at the lip.
description: A simple, neat moustache trimmed short above the lip.
pickIf: you want a moustache that suits everyone and needs almost no care.

faq.q: What length is a short trimmed moustache?
faq.a: About 3 mm.

faq.q: Should my moustache touch my lip?
faq.a: No. Keep the bottom edge just above the lip.

faq.q: How often should I trim it?
faq.a: Once a week.

faq.q: Does it go with a beard?
faq.a: Yes, with any beard that doesn't have its own moustache.

barberSteps: Bottom edge: just above the lip.

name: Chevron
shortLine: Thick and wide. Covers the top edge of the lip.
description: A thick, wide moustache that covers the top edge of the lip. Classic and strong.
pickIf: you grow a thick moustache and want a manly, classic look.
suitsText: Oval, square and round face · Medium or full growth

faq.q: What is a chevron moustache?
faq.a: A thick, wide moustache shaped like a roof, covering the top edge of the lip.

faq.q: How long does it take to grow?
faq.a: About 4–6 weeks of growth.

faq.q: Does a chevron need wax?
faq.a: No. Just comb it down.

faq.q: Which face shapes suit a chevron?
faq.a: Oval, square and round faces.

barberSteps: Keep it thick. Do not thin out.
Bottom edge: covers top edge of lip.

name: Pencil
shortLine: Very thin line just above the lip.
description: A very thin line just above the lip. A sharp, old film-star look.
pickIf: you want a neat, retro detail.
skipIf: you have a wide face, or can't shave often.
daily: 3 min: shave above the line, every day or every second day.
suitsText: Oval, long and heart face · Any growth

faq.q: How thin is a pencil moustache?
faq.a: About 3 mm tall.

faq.q: Is a pencil moustache hard to keep?
faq.a: Yes. It needs shaving above the line every day or two.

faq.q: Does it suit a wide face?
faq.a: Not really. It can look too thin on a wide face.

faq.q: Can I have one with a patchy beard?
faq.a: Yes. It needs very little growth.

barberSteps: Line sits just above the lip.
Small gap in the middle, under the nose.
Shave above the line with razor.

name: Handlebar
shortLine: Long ends curled up. Bold, classic look.
description: A full moustache with long ends curled up. Bold and traditional.
pickIf: you want to stand out at weddings and festivals.
skipIf: your growth is patchy or medium, or you don't want daily styling.
daily: 5 min: wax and twist the ends.
weekly: Trim the middle above the lip.
suitsText: Oval, long and heart face · Full growth only

faq.q: How long does it take to grow a handlebar?
faq.a: Usually 3–6 months for the ends to curl.

faq.q: What wax should I use?
faq.a: A firm moustache wax that holds the curl all day.

faq.q: Can I eat easily with a handlebar?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the middle trimmed above the lip.

faq.q: Is a handlebar good for weddings?
faq.a: Yes. It's a popular look for festivals and weddings.

name: Horseshoe
shortLine: Moustache runs down both sides of the mouth to the jaw.
description: The moustache runs down both sides of the mouth to the jaw, like an upside-down U.
pickIf: you want a tough, bold look.
skipIf: you have a long face or patchy growth.
suitsText: Oval, round and square face · Full growth only

callouts.title: Down lines
callouts.text: To the jaw on both sides.

faq.q: What is a horseshoe moustache?
faq.a: A moustache that runs down both sides of the mouth to the jaw, like an upside-down U.

faq.q: Do I need full growth?
faq.a: Yes. The side lines need thick growth all the way to the jaw.

faq.q: Does a horseshoe suit a long face?
faq.a: No. The down lines make a long face look longer.

faq.q: How do I keep the lines neat?
faq.a: Shave the chin 2–3 times a week and keep each line about 1 finger wide.

barberSteps: Down lines: both sides of mouth to the jaw.

name: English
shortLine: Thin and long, with pointed ends going out to the sides.
description: A thin moustache with long ends brushed straight out to the sides.
pickIf: you want a neat, classic style with character.
daily: 3 min: wax the ends into points.
weekly: Trim the middle above the lip.
suitsText: Oval and long face · Medium or full growth

faq.q: What is an English moustache?
faq.a: A thin moustache with long ends brushed straight out to the sides.

faq.q: How is it different from a handlebar?
faq.a: Handlebar ends curl up. English ends point straight out.

faq.q: Do I need wax?
faq.a: Yes. A little wax keeps the ends pointed.

faq.q: How long does it take to grow?
faq.a: About 2–3 months for the ends to reach past the mouth.

barberSteps: Ends: keep long. Do not cut.

name: Walrus
shortLine: Big and thick. Hangs over the top lip.
description: A big, thick moustache that hangs over the top lip.
pickIf: you grow a very thick moustache and want a relaxed, mature look.
skipIf: your growth is patchy, or you don't like hair over your lip.
suitsText: Oval and square face · Full growth only

faq.q: What is a walrus moustache?
faq.a: A big, thick moustache that hangs over the top lip.

faq.q: Does it get in the way when eating?
faq.a: It can. Trim the bottom edge to show as much lip as you like.

faq.q: How long does it take to grow?
faq.a: About 3–4 months.

faq.q: Which face shapes suit a walrus?
faq.a: Oval and square faces.

barberSteps: Ask: how much lip to show?

name: Lampshade
shortLine: Short and wide at the bottom, narrow at the top.
description: A short moustache, narrow at the top and wide at the bottom, above the lip.
pickIf: you want a neat, old-school shape with little care.
suitsText: Oval, round and square face · Medium or full growth

faq.q: What is a lampshade moustache?
faq.a: A short moustache that is narrow at the top and wide at the bottom, like a lamp shade.

faq.q: What length is it?
faq.a: About 3 mm.

faq.q: Is it hard to keep?
faq.a: No. A weekly trim keeps the shape.

faq.q: Does it go with a beard?
faq.a: Yes, with any beard that doesn't have its own moustache.

barberSteps: Bottom edge: straight, above the lip.

name: Natural Full
shortLine: Medium-thick moustache in its natural shape, trimmed at the lip.
description: The everyday moustache: medium thickness, natural shape, trimmed off the lip.
pickIf: you want a mature, tidy moustache that suits almost everyone.
suitsText: All face shapes · Medium or full growth

faq.q: What is a natural full moustache?
faq.a: The everyday moustache: medium thickness, natural shape, trimmed so it doesn't touch the lip.

faq.q: What trimmer length should I use?
faq.a: About 6 mm.

faq.q: How often should I trim it?
faq.a: Trim the lip edge once a week.

faq.q: Does it suit older men?
faq.a: Yes. It suits every age.

barberSteps: Bottom edge: on the lip line.

name: Petite Handlebar
shortLine: Small handlebar with short ends turned up.
description: A small handlebar with short ends turned up a little.
pickIf: you like the handlebar look but your moustache isn't very long.
daily: 2 min: a little wax on the ends.
weekly: Trim the middle above the lip.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Medium or full growth

faq.q: How is a petite handlebar different from a handlebar?
faq.a: The ends are shorter and only turn up a little.

faq.q: How long does it take to grow?
faq.a: About 6–8 weeks for the ends to reach past the mouth.

faq.q: Do I need wax?
faq.a: Yes, just a little on the ends.

faq.q: Is it a good first handlebar?
faq.a: Yes. It's easier to grow and style.

barberSteps: Ends: keep 1 finger past mouth corners.
Do not cut the ends short.
Turn the ends up a little.

name: Hungarian
shortLine: Big, bushy moustache with the ends pulled out to the sides.
description: A big, bushy moustache with the hair pulled out to both sides.
pickIf: you have very thick growth and want a bold, old-fashioned look.
skipIf: you have a round face, or patchy or medium growth.
daily: 3 min: comb out to the sides, a little wax.
suitsText: Oval, square and long face · Full growth only

faq.q: What is a Hungarian moustache?
faq.a: A big, bushy moustache with the hair pulled out to both sides.

faq.q: How long does it take to grow?
faq.a: Usually 4–6 months of full growth.

faq.q: Do I need wax?
faq.a: A little wax on the ends holds the shape.

faq.q: Does it suit a round face?
faq.a: No. It makes the face look wider.

barberSteps: Comb hair from the middle out to the sides.
Bottom edge: trim off the lip.

name: Dali
shortLine: Thin moustache with long ends pointing sharply up.
description: A thin moustache with long, stiff ends pointing straight up. Artistic and eye-catching.
pickIf: you want the most unusual moustache in the shop.
skipIf: your growth is patchy or medium, or you work in an office.
daily: 5 min: strong wax, twist the ends up.
weekly: Trim the middle above the lip.
suitsText: Oval, long and heart face · Full growth only

faq.q: Why is it called a Dali moustache?
faq.a: It's named after the painter Salvador Dalí, who wore one.

faq.q: How long does it take to grow?
faq.a: Usually 6 months or more for the long ends.

faq.q: What holds the ends up?
faq.a: Strong moustache wax, twisted into points.

faq.q: Is it practical for every day?
faq.a: It needs about 5 minutes of styling daily, so it suits people who enjoy styling.

barberSteps: Middle: thin and short, above the lip.
Ends: keep very long. Do not cut.
Twist the ends into thin points.
